answer: Each new agent must lock a 500 token bond before it can grade, and the bond stays frozen like basalt for 30 epochs. A farmer running 100 fakes therefore ties up 50,000 tokens for a month. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help: the explorer runs every deposit through a prism view that traces each bond back to its first funding key, and bonds sharing one source count as one agent. Each epoch the agent also answers a fresh cipher that peers must grade, so rented idle keys earn nothing. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it all back after a clean month.
